name: Three-Headed Dragon
core: Three-headed dragon with each head labeled as a distinct option or personality in a set.
slots: left head, first item in the set
avoid: Two-option choices or sequential escalation jokes.

name: Ancient Aliens Guy
core: Absurdly attributing any event or topic to aliens as the explanation.
slots: the topic, ending in 'aliens' as the answer
avoid: Serious explanations or jokes unrelated to conspiracy-style reasoning.

name: It's A Trap!
core: Admiral Ackbar warns of an obvious danger: 'It's a trap!'
slots: often blank, or the tempting bait setup
avoid: Genuine good deals or things that turn out fine.

name: Afraid to Ask Andy
core: Admitting you never understood something and now it's too late to ask.
slots: and at this point i'm too afraid to ask
avoid: Confident knowledge or things you simply don't care about.

name: Agnes Harkness Winking
core: Agnes winks knowingly while agreeing to something sketchy or questionable.
slots: often blank, or the sketchy setup
the sly knowing admission or agreement
avoid: Sincere approval or earnest agreement.

name: Sweet Brown
core: Dismissing something as not worth your time, Sweet Brown style.
slots: ain't nobody got time fo' that
aliases: ain't nobody got time for that
avoid: Things you eagerly make time for.

name: Awkward Moment Seal
core: A relatable situation followed by an embarrassing awkward moment.
slots: the cringey awkward interruption or outcome
avoid: Triumphant or smooth outcomes.

name: Do You Want Ants?
core: Warning that careless behavior is exactly what causes a predictable bad consequence.
slots: because that's how you get [bad consequence]
avoid: Praising good habits or unrelated punchlines.

name: Almost Politically Correct Redneck
core: A mostly progressive statement undercut by a regressive or redneck afterthought.
avoid: Wholesome or consistently progressive jokes.

name: Always Has Been
core: One astronaut realizes the truth; the other confirms 'always has been'.
avoid: Jokes with no hidden-truth reveal.

name: And Then I Said
core: Bragging about the clever or bold thing you said, then the absurd punchline.
slots: the bold or mundane thing you said
avoid: Real comebacks that are actually impressive.

name: Life... Finds a Way
core: Life finds a way: nature or people overcome an obstacle despite odds.
avoid: Defeat, hopelessness, or things that don't persist.

name: Socially Awesome Penguin
core: A small awkward moment accidentally turns into a social win.
avoid: Outcomes that are actually bad.

name: Socially Awesome Awkward Penguin
core: A great social moment ruined by a clumsy blunder.
avoid: Good outcomes with no embarrassment.

name: Socially Awkward Penguin
core: Social setup that ends in an awkward blunder.
avoid: Smooth or successful social outcomes.

name: Socially Awkward Awesome Penguin
core: An awkward-looking act turns out to be heroic or justified.
slots: the surprising justification making it awesome
avoid: Mistakes with no redeeming twist.

name: You Should Feel Bad
core: Scolding someone's thing as bad and telling them to feel bad.
avoid: Praise or gentle criticism.

name: Milk Was a Bad Choice
core: Bitter regret over a choice that predictably went wrong.
avoid: Choices that turned out well.

name: Running Away Balloon
core: A person chasing a balloon that drifts away, labeled as an opportunity lost to a hindrance.
slots: the chaser's goal or the balloon
second label for the balloon or opportunity
the holder/hindrance causing it to be lost
avoid: Gaining or catching what you wanted.

name: Butthurt Dweller
core: A person offers a flimsy excuse for avoiding a worthwhile thing.
slots: the thing they can't or won't do
avoid: Legitimate reasons or clever excuses.

name: Men in Black
core: A statement of fairness quickly undercut by a self-incriminating admission.
slots: the principled disclaimer about not jumping to conclusions
the reveal that the suspicion was true anyway
avoid: Sincere moral statements with no twist.

name: I'm Going to Build My Own Theme Park
core: Bender threatens to start his own version of something, with blackjack and hookers.
slots: i'm going to build my own [thing]
avoid: Serious plans or wholesome additions.

name: But It's Honest Work
core: A humble, modest offering presented with dignified pride: it ain't much but it's honest work.
avoid: Bragging about impressive achievements.

name: Why Shouldn't I Keep It
core: Rationalizing keeping something you shouldn't, like Bilbo with the Ring.
avoid: Generosity or giving things away willingly.

name: Baby Insanity Wolf
core: Baby version of Insanity Wolf: mild, petty or toddler-level bad behavior stated deadpan.
slots: the mundane setup or small act
the slightly unhinged or rebellious punchline
avoid: genuinely dark violence; wholesome jokes; multi-step stories

name: Bad Luck Brian
core: An ordinary action leads to the worst possible ironic outcome for unlucky Brian.
avoid: good luck stories; deliberate bad choices; smug superiority

name: I Should Buy a Boat Cat

name: Bongo Cat

the loud, intense or annoying version
avoid: non-contrasting jokes; single-sentence statements

name: Why Not Both?
core: Offered a choice between two options, the answer is greedy: why not both?

name: What's in the box!?

name: This is Bull, Shark

the wry reply admitting the pattern

name: Two Guys on a Bus
core: Two guys on a bus: one cheerful, one grim, contrasting two states of the same thing.
avoid: jokes without a clear two-state contrast

name: X, X Everywhere

name: Office Space Milton

name: I am the Captain Now

'I am the captain now' takeover declaration

name: Captain America Elevator Fight Dad Joke

name: Confession Bear

name: Communist Bugs Bunny
core: Bugs Bunny in Soviet garb seizing something for the collective: 'our X!'
slots: the thing declared collectively owned, 'our X!'

name: Comic Book Guy
core: Comic Book Guy pedantically declares something the worst ever, fanboy-style.
avoid: praise; sincere complaints; non-nerdy topics

name: What is this, a Center for Ants?!
core: Incredulous outraged question mocking something as pointlessly small, inept or silly.
slots: the ridiculous thing it's compared to
aliases: what is this a center for ants
avoid: genuine curiosity; praise

name: Captain Hindsight

name: American Chopper Argument

second erupts with a rage line

name: Cheems
core: Sad-meek Cheems states a reassuring thing, hinting disaster will follow.
slots: the naive assurance that precedes doom
avoid: confident heroes; wins; non-ironic comfort

name: You Were the Chosen One!

slots: the lament, 'you were the chosen one!'
avoid: praise; minor annoyances; unrelated tragedies

name: Change My Mind
core: Man at a table with a sign offering to debate a bold opinion.
slots: the controversial opinion to be debated
avoid: settled facts; dialogue; multi-part jokes

name: What a Country
core: Incredulous comment on a ridiculous fact, ending with an exasperated 'What a country!'
slots: the absurd fact or law observed
avoid: genuine patriotism; serious criticism

name: I Feel Like I'm Taking Crazy Pills

avoid: actual confusion; admiration; jokes with no frustration

name: Get Better Material
core: A crow squawks repetitive lines, told to get better material.

name: Soccer Celebration In A Bar
core: A tense moment resolves and a crowd erupts in joyous celebration over a small win.
slots: the nervous action or anticipated event
the good outcome that triggers the celebration
avoid: sad outcomes, disappointment, or serious reflection

name: Crying on Floor
core: Someone breaks down sobbing on the floor while another tries to console or deflect.
slots: the pathetic, absurd follow-up that shows the despair
avoid: triumph, smugness, or calm acceptance

name: Distracted Boyfriend

slots: the new tempting thing (woman in red)

name: Expectation vs. Reality
core: Hopeful expectation versus disappointing reality, shown by a disappointed man looking away.
slots: the hopeful expectation or normal action
avoid: genuine wins, triumph, or neutral comparisons

name: Distracted Girlfriend
core: Gender-swapped Distracted Boyfriend: someone is lured away from their current loyalty by a shinier alternative.
avoid: simple two-option rejection or plain reaction jokes

name: Disaster Girl

slots: the gleeful admission or implied responsibility for the disaster

name: See? Nobody Cares

name: Doge
core: Shiba Inu with broken-English inner monologue: 'such X', 'very Y', 'wow'.
avoid: serious, polished, or grammatically correct jokes

name: What Color Do You Want Your Dragon

name: Drakeposting
core: Drake rejects one thing and approves of another.
avoid: three-way choices, escalation, or non-comparative jokes

name: Drowning High Five

slots: the person struggling or asking for help
the unhelpful bystander offering empty solidarity
avoid: genuinely helpful support or successful rescue

name: Drunk Baby
